messages.text: Set up who your assistant is, how it behaves, and what happens to it.
Your assistant's name and what it does. Save when you're done.
Shape how your assistant replies and learns. Changes save on their own.
Gets better over time by learning from the way you correct it.
Run a nightly memory-consolidation pass (3am) that promotes recurring details into long-term memory. Off by default.
Detect customer sentiment and adjust tone accordingly.
Choose the tone your assistant replies in.
Terminal access falls back to your login session. Generate a key to require the .pem and encrypt backups.

The private key is shown once at generation and never stored on our servers. This key grants terminal access and is required for encrypted backups. Regenerate to rotate the key, which immediately revokes the previous one.
Let other software send this agent a message and read its answer, over the open A2A protocol. A key reaches this agent only, acts with your permissions, and can be revoked on its own.
Save a full copy of your assistant so you can restore it later or move it somewhere else.
A complete copy of your assistant - its name, personality, memory, and settings. Saved automatically, but you can save one anytime.
Choose this if you want to run your assistant on your own systems.
Destructive actions live here. Proceed carefully.
Permanently remove this agent, all its subagents, conversations, and files. This can't be undone.

changelog.note: Initial capture as user 1 on Asta. Tests that change Role, Dream Mode or Response Tone put the original value back through the UI. The key list, tokens and description text are live data and never asserted. Generate access key, New key Create, Backup now, the downloads and Delete Agent are never clicked.
